stem.text: Bacteria were grown in a medium containing $^{15}\mathrm{N}$. After several generations, all of the DNA contained $^{15}\mathrm{N}$. Some of these bacteria were transferred to a medium containing the common isotope of nitrogen, $^{14}\mathrm{N}$. The bacteria were allowed to divide once. The DNA of some of these bacteria was extracted and analysed. This DNA was all hybrid DNA containing equal amounts of $^{14}\mathrm{N}$ and $^{15}\mathrm{N}$.

In another experiment, some bacteria from the medium with $^{15}\mathrm{N}$ were transferred into a medium of $^{14}\mathrm{N}$. The bacteria were allowed to divide three times. The DNA of some of these bacteria was extracted and analysed.
What is the composition of this DNA?

A.alt: Percentage of DNA with nitrogen-14 and hybrid nitrogen-14/nitrogen-15, option A.

B.alt: Percentage of DNA with nitrogen-14 and hybrid nitrogen-14/nitrogen-15, option B.

C.alt: Percentage of DNA with nitrogen-14 and hybrid nitrogen-14/nitrogen-15, option C.

D.alt: Percentage of DNA with nitrogen-14 and hybrid nitrogen-14/nitrogen-15, option D.
